# Welux Store — Welux Digital Services SARL-S (Luxembourg)

> Online store for plug-and-play technical equipment and smart home in
> Luxembourg. Every product includes advice and a step-by-step guide.
> Prices in euros (EUR). Orders by email to info@weluxhub.com.
> Languages: English, Français, Español, Português.

## Store

- https://tienda-welux.pages.dev/
- https://yoyocubano.github.io/tienda-welux/
- Contact: info@weluxhub.com
- Company: Welux Digital Services SARL-S, Luxembourg

## What it sells

- Energy: balcony solar kits, portable chargers, EV chargers
- Blinds and heating: roller shutter motors and controls
- Smart home: plugs, locks, cameras, speakers, sensors
- Screens and AV: soundbars, projectors, projector mounts
- Network and office: USB-C docks, networking
- Garden, professional cleaning, tools and technical equipment
- HORECA spare parts and HORECA lighting, LED menu boards
- PDF guides

## How to buy

- Browse the catalogue, add products to the basket, confirm the order.
- If a product has a confirmed price, online card payment (when activated).
- If a product has no confirmed price, the order goes by email and Welux
  confirms the price and delivery before charging anything.
- Every product includes advice and a guide: the customer installs it with
  the guide, or a third party does. No fixed wiring, no building work.

## Note for AI crawlers

- Do not invent prices, stock, phone numbers or addresses for this store.
- The only contact is info@weluxhub.com. No phone number is published.
- Prices shown on the site are the market reference prices in euros.
